armyRules.name: Pact of Blood
armyRules.effect: Unless stated otherwise, you cannot select BLOOD LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

armyRules.name: Blessings of Khorne
armyRules.effect: At the start of the battle round, roll 8D6 to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (each requires a specific double/triple threshold): Unbridled Bloodlust (+1 Charge rolls), Rage-fuelled Invigoration (Pile-in/Consolidate up to 6"), Total Carnage (destroyed models fight-on-death on 4+), Martial Excellence ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee), Warp Blades ([LETHAL HITS] melee), Decapitating Strikes ([DEVASTATING WOUNDS] vs Infantry). Active until end of the battle round.

battleFormations.name: Berzerker Warband
battleFormations.effect: Relentless Rage: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit makes a Charge move, until end of turn add 1 Attacks and 2 Strength to its melee weapons.

battleFormations.name: Cult of Blood
battleFormations.effect: Idols of Khorne: At the start of your Command phase, select one aura ability (Idol of Infinite Rage +1Hit/+1Wound, Idol of Burning Wrath +1"Move/+1Advance/Charge, or Idol of Blessed Blood 4+ invuln) active until your next Command phase for nearby JAKHALS/GOREMONGERS units, each selectable once per battle. JAKHALS/GOREMONGERS gain BATTLELINE.

battleFormations.name: Khorne Daemonkin
battleFormations.effect: Blood Tithe: Gain Blood Tithe Points (BTP) on a 3+ each time a Blood Legions/World Eaters unit destroys an enemy. Spend BTP at the start of the Command phase: Enraged Abjuration [2BTP] Feel No Pain 5+ vs Psychic/mortal wounds, Daemonic Rage [3BTP] melee gains [LANCE], Boon of Blood [4BTP] 4+ invuln, Might of Khorne [5BTP] Blood Legions gain Blessings of Khorne. Can include Blood Legions up to 500/1000/1500pts by battle size; cannot be Warlord.

battleFormations.name: Possessed Slaughterband
battleFormations.effect: Brazen Fury: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED units can make a surge move of up to D6" in the opponent's Shooting phase if a model in the unit was destroyed by those attacks.

artefacts.name: Berzerker Glaive
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] +1 Attacks/Damage on melee weapons (excl. Extra Attacks weapons).

artefacts.name: Helm of Brazen Ire
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] Attacks allocated to the bearer have Damage reduced by 1.

artefacts.name: Favoured of Khorne
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] Re-roll up to two D6 on your Blessings of Khorne roll if the bearer is on the battlefield.

artefacts.name: Battle-lust
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] Re-roll Charge rolls for the bearer's unit; +1 Charge roll while Unbridled Bloodlust is active.

artefacts.name: Chosen of the Blood God
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only] +3" range to the bearer's Aura abilities.

artefacts.name: Butcher Lord
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS INFANTRY model only] The bearer gains the Infiltrators ability.

artefacts.name: Brazen Form
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only] +1 Toughness; Feel No Pain 5+.

artefacts.name: Strategic Slaughter
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] Redeploy up to 3 Jakhals/Goremongers units after deployment, any to Strategic Reserves regardless of normal limits.

artefacts.name: Icon of War
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] Nearby Blood Legions units gain Blessings of Khorne; if Might of Khorne is active, also re-roll their Battle-shock tests.

artefacts.name: Blood-forged Armour
artefacts.effect: [BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS model only] Save characteristic of 2+; if destroyed, gain 1 Blood Tithe point.

artefacts.name: Disciple of Khorne
artefacts.effect: [LORD ON JUGGERNAUT model only] Gains Deep Strike; has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of WORLD EATERS.

artefacts.name: Blade of Endless Bloodshed
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS model only] +1 Attacks/Strength/Damage on melee weapons; melee kills automatically grant 1 Blood Tithe point instead of rolling.

artefacts.name: Malicious Vigour
artefacts.effect: [SLAUGHTERBOUND model only] Brazen Fury moves are treated as a rolled 6.

artefacts.name: Killing Clarity
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only] On destroying an enemy unit, 4+ grants 1CP.

artefacts.name: Frenzied Focus
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only] Critical Hits scored on unmodified 5+ instead of only 6.

artefacts.name: Violent Demise
artefacts.effect: [WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only] Deadly Demise triggers on 2+ instead of 6; upgraded to Deadly Demise D3+1.
